modmenu.descriptionTranslation.obs_overl: Hide HUD elements from OBS stream by making them an overlay.
obs_overlay.config.title: OBS Overlay Settings
obs_overlay.config.hud.intro:
Components enabled here are still drawn on your own screen, but they are left out of the captured frame - so they never show up in OBS.
Start with the debug menu, then add whatever must not leak: chat, scoreboard, player list...
obs_overlay.config.screens.intro: Whole screens can be hidden the same way. Their content, background and background blur stay out of the capture, so nothing in the stream gives away that a menu is open.
obs_overlay.config.advanced.intro:
Diagnostics and fine tuning.
How to verify: enable the test icon - a small magenta square is drawn on top of everything. It must be visible in game and invisible in the OBS preview. If it shows up in OBS, the mod is not active: look for the [obs_overlay] lines in the log and make sure Video Settings > Graphics API is OpenGL.
obs_overlay.config.overlay_hint: Enabled: visible on your screen, invisible in the OBS capture.
obs_overlay.config.auto_hide_hint: Enabled: not drawn at all while any screen is open (so it disappears from your screen too).
obs_overlay.config.screen_hint: Enabled: this screen, its content and its background blur stay out of the OBS capture.
obs_overlay.config.hide_all_screens.tool: Hide every in-game screen (inventory, containers, pause menu, ...) from OBS. The individual switches below have no effect while this is on.
obs_overlay.config.config_file:
Config file: %s
Hand edits take effect on the next game start; switches changed in this screen apply immediately.
obs_overlay.config.components_to_overlay: Select components to hide from OBS:
Selected components will be rendered as an overlay, and therefore hidden from OBS' game capture
obs_overlay.config.auto_hide_components: Select components to hide when any interface is open:
Since hidden components are rendered as an overlay, they might still be visible on top of any interface.
Selected components will be hidden completely when any interface is open
obs_overlay.config.requires_overlay_enab: Requires '%s' to be hidden from OBS
obs_overlay.config.show_test_icon: Show test icon in the top left corner
obs_overlay.config.show_test_icon.toolti:
This will enable a test icon that will be visible anywhere but hidden in the stream.
You can use it to quickly check if overlay components are not visible
obs_overlay.config.screens_to_overlay: Select screens to hide from OBS:
obs_overlay.config.screens_to_overlay.to: Selected screens will be rendered as an overlay, and therefore hidden from OBS' game capture.
obs_overlay.config.enable_custom_handled: Enable custom list of screens to hide from OBS

This enables a list of identifiers of screens that will be rendered as an overlay.
Not every screen in the game has an identifier, those are not supported
obs_overlay.config.custom_handled_screen:
Those are the identifiers of ScreenHandler types.
You can find a full list of possible identifiers below
obs_overlay.config.existing_handled_scre: You can use values found in this list to enter into the list above
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.debug_: An F3 menu containing debug information including coordinates, chunk information, etc
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.chat.t: Chat messages excluding the input field
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.chat_b: Chat input field with autocomplete suggestions
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.player: A player list displayed when pressing TAB
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.subtit:
Audio subtitles displayed in the right lower corner
Disabled by default, can be enabled in accessibility settings
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.scoreb:
A score table located on the right side of the screen.
Can be set using /scoreboard command
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.action:
A message displayed above the hotbar.
Can be set using /title @p actionbar
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.title_:
A big message displayed in the middle of the screen.
Can be set using /title @p title and /title @p subtitle
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.effect: Potion effects displayed in the top right corner of the screen
obs_overlay.component.obs_overlay.main_h: Main HUD elements including hotbar, health, hunger, armor, experience, etc
obs_overlay.config.premultiplied_alpha.t: HUD content is drawn premultiplied by the 26.3 GUI pipelines. Only change this if the overlay looks washed out or too bright.
obs_overlay.toast.no_hook: The swap hook could not be installed, nothing will be hidden from OBS. See the log.
obs_overlay.toast.not_firing: The swap hook never fired (SDL/OpenGL path), nothing will be hidden from OBS. See the log.
